name: Boon of Magic School Mastery

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Choose a school. A chosen level 1 spell of that school from your class list is always prepared and castable without slots or components. A chosen level 7-or-lower spell of that school is always prepared and free once per Long Rest; both can use slots. Repeating the feat requires a different school (enforce manually).
